Soy socio ACA hace años. No reciben débito. El lugar de aseo deja mucho que desear. Compré un sándwich con cartel "hecho en el día" y cuando lo pedí, sacaron el de atrás en la heladera... Oh sorpresa, vencido.

(Translated by Google)
I've been an ACA member for years. They don't accept debit cards. The restrooms leave much to be desired. I bought a sandwich labeled "made fresh daily," and when I asked for it, they took the one from the back of the refrigerator... Surprise, surprise, it was expired.
